freeTierSummary.zh-CN: 通过邀请链接注册的新用户可领取赠送额度（当前宣传为 99 元，具体额度与有效期以控制台为准）。平台为 OpenAI 兼容 LLM 网关，聚合 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash / V4-Pro、GLM-5.3-Flash、Qwen3.8-Flash / Max、MiniMax 等国模，按 token 计费、价格较低（如 GLM-5.3-Flash 输入 ¥0.88 / 百万 tokens，DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 输入 ¥2.2 / 百万 tokens）。
freeTierSummary.en: New users who register through an invitation link receive promotional credits (currently advertised as ¥99; the exact quota and validity are shown in the console). An OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway aggregating DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash / V4-Pro, GLM-5.3-Flash, Qwen3.8-Flash / Max and MiniMax at low per-token prices (e.g. GLM-5.3-Flash input ¥0.88 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash input ¥2.2 per million tokens).

zh-CN: 打开邀请链接 https://opencsg.com/signup?invitationCode=S2KM2WN2EY 注册 OpenCSG 账号
注册成功后新用户赠送额度自动到账（当前宣传 99 元），具体额度与有效期以控制台为准
在控制台创建 API Key（明文仅创建时显示一次，请立即保存）
Base URL 填 https://ai.space.opencsg.com/v1，模型填平台模型 ID（如 deepseek-v4.1-flash）；公开模型清单见 https://ai.space.opencsg.com/v1/models
en: Register an OpenCSG account via the invitation link https://opencsg.com/signup?invitationCode=S2KM2WN2EY
New-user promotional credits (currently advertised as ¥99) are granted after signup; check the console for the exact quota and validity
Create an API key in the console (the plaintext is shown only once — save it immediately)
Use https://ai.space.opencsg.com/v1 as the base URL with platform model ids (e.g. deepseek-v4.1-flash); the public model list is at https://ai.space.opencsg.com/v1/models
